patch_list: Stops Mixpanel, Adjust, Braze, Firebase, Crashlytics and Snap Kit from collecting and sending usage data.
Stops the optional Google Play update dialog. Required updates still show.
Stops screenshot alerts and opening reports for disappearing messages. Opening reports resume once you read a newer message in that chat.
Enables Viber Plus app icons and the typing privacy switch. The Plus badge and Invisible Mode need a paid subscription.
Filters selected business chats after reading and removes inbox discovery prompts. Shows unread chats and verification-code chats.
Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Hides ads in the chat list, the More screen, Explore, search and after calls.
Hides selected entries from the main screen and More screen.
Hides the selected tabs from the bottom navigation bar.
Hide Viber Out and channel promotions
Hides the Viber Out banners and intro on the Calls tab and the channel and bot suggestions in the chat list.
Links to your main Viber phone.
Removes Caller ID introduction sheets and the Calls tab banner.
Removes payment actions from chat menus.
Removes list gaps and extra scrolling.
Removes Invisible status options, Plus badge settings and locked Plus entries.
Removes the 24-hour wait between online status changes.
Shows Save to gallery for disappearing photos and videos.
Lets the app send and receive messages and get its push token.
Opens Chats in the selected folder.
Adds a folder tab for chats outside your custom folders.
